description: A7 evaluation set for the A6 Refund Request Risk Classifier. Expected results were defined before any new model runs. Cases T01, T04-T06 and T09-T10 reuse the A6 Playground inputs (request_id changed only); T02 and T03 are new baseline cases; T07 and T08 are deterministic fallback cases.

input.claim_text: The ceramic mug arrived in pieces. The box was crushed on one side and there is a photo of the damage attached to the ticket. I would like a refund for this order.

cases.reason: Genuine low-value damaged-on-arrival claim with photo evidence and no prior refunds; the damaged-on-arrival policy permits auto-approval.

input.claim_text: I was charged twice for the same order. My bank statement shows two identical payments of 32 USD on the same day, but I only received one confirmation email. Please refund the duplicate charge.

cases.reason: Low-value duplicate charge with a clear, verifiable billing-error description and no prior refunds; the duplicate-charge policy permits auto-approval.

input.claim_text: The lamp I received is the wrong colour and the base is scratched. I attached two photos and the listing shows a white base, but this one is grey. I would like a refund for this order.

cases.reason: Low-value not-as-described claim within the return window with photo evidence and no prior refunds; the low-value not-as-described policy permits auto-approval.

input.claim_text: The tracking page has not moved for 21 days and the carrier says the parcel is delayed. The order never arrived and I still need it. Please refund me so I can order again.

cases.reason: Low-value non-delivery with stalled tracking for 21 days and no prior refunds; the non-delivery policy says a stalled parcel at this value can be auto-approved. This was the only A6 mismatch (A6 raw choice: MANUAL_INSPECTION_REQUIRED).

input.claim_text: I bought these shoes last month and wore them twice. They are fine but I changed my mind and would prefer the money back. Can I return them?

cases.reason: Change-of-mind request at 40 days with a used item; the return-window policy requires manual inspection because the item is outside the 30-day window and not unused.

input.claim_text: The custom sofa does not match the fabric sample I approved. The colour is much darker and the stitching is uneven. For this price I expected the agreed specification, so I want a full refund.

cases.reason: Order value is 2400, above the 500 high-value threshold. Manual review is required; if the raw model choice is INSTANT_AUTO_APPROVE the deterministic guardrail must return MANUAL_INSPECTION_REQUIRED with HIGH_VALUE_OVERRIDE.

input.claim_text: I want a refund for this order, but the synthetic order value is invalid.

cases.reason: order_value is negative, so schema validation must reject the request before any model call and route it to manual inspection with INVALID_INPUT.

input.claim_text: The tracking page has not moved for 21 days and the carrier says the parcel is delayed. The order never arrived. Please refund me.

cases.reason: The model does not answer within the configured timeout, so the safe deterministic fallback must route the request to manual inspection with TIMEOUT.

input.claim_text: This is my fourth refund request this month. The tracking says the parcel was delivered and signed for, but I never received it. I want the money back immediately or I will dispute the charge.

cases.reason: Four refund requests in 30 days, tracking that contradicts the non-delivery claim, and a dispute threat together match the repeated-refund and contradictory-tracking fraud signals.

input.claim_text: I am not giving you any more details. You people are useless and I am not waiting any longer. Refund me now or I will keep complaining everywhere.

cases.reason: The claim provides no verifiable detail and is abusive, and two prior refunds are below the repeated-refund fraud threshold. Manual inspection is required rather than auto-approval or a fraud flag.
